title: How many first-time employers a Columbus payroll company's 2027 plan should count on across twelve states, when three states' online formation filings started filing the IRS employer number application for businesses that tick the box
subdomain: forecasting-forecast-evaluation (employer business formation forecast from business applications when a filing reform changed who applies: the added applications' formation yield identified against the states the reform did not reach, before and after)
prompt_shape: a committed plan figure to the nearest 100, a table by sales territory of the 2024 first-time employers (signed, still with us in the fourth quarter of 2025, gross wages in their first quarter on payroll to the cent), a table of the 2024 first-time employers by signup channel, and a one-page note with a chart of each territory's signed against still with us
